**Creating graphs with Altair**

I should provide code that likely uses Altair and Vega for graphing the dataset. The code will probably focus on Altair for visualizations. I need to mention an example dataset, like "seattle-weather.csv" from vega_datasets, which I can read using pandas read_csv.

I’ll aim for conciseness while crafting my response, and I plan to include a couple of charts to illustrate the graphs effectively. Let’s get started on that!
[/Thinking]

Here’s a simple Altair example for graphing the `seattle-weather.csv` dataset:

```python
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vega/vega-datasets/master/data/seattle-weather.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(url)

# Optional: make sure date is parsed as datetime
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])

# Example 1: Daily max temperature over time, colored by weather type
chart = alt.Chart(df).mark_circle(size=50).encode(
    x=alt.X("date:T", title="Date"),
    y=alt.Y("temp_max:Q", title="Max Temperature (°C)"),
    color=alt.Color("weather:N", title="Weather"),
    tooltip=["date:T", "temp_max:Q", "temp_min:Q", "weather:N", "precipitation:Q"]
).properties(
    title="Seattle Weather: Max Temperature Over Time",
    width=700,
    height=400
)

chart
```

If you want a different kind of graph, here are two common alternatives:

### 1) Temperature line chart
```python
line_chart = alt.Chart(df).mark_line().encode(
    x=alt.X("date:T", title="Date"),
    y=alt.Y("temp_max:Q", title="Max Temperature (°C)"),
    color=alt.Color("weather:N", title="Weather")
).properties(
    title="Seattle Weather: Max Temperature Over Time",
    width=700,
    height=400
)

line_chart
```

### 2) Precipitation vs temperature scatter plot
```python
scatter_chart = alt.Chart(df).mark_point().encode(
    x=alt.X("temp_min:Q", title="Min Temperature (°C)"),
    y=alt.Y("precipitation:Q", title="Precipitation (mm)"),
    color=alt.Color("weather:N", title="Weather"),
    tooltip=["date:T", "temp_min:Q", "precipitation:Q", "weather:N"]
).properties(
    title="Seattle Weather: Precipitation vs Min Temperature",
    width=700,
    height=400
)

scatter_chart
```

If you want, I can also give you:
- a **bar chart** version,
- a **facet chart by weather type**, or
- a **fully interactive Altair chart**.
